description: Builds one calendar event the user adds themselves. Use when the user wants to schedule a meeting, send an invite or get an .ics file. Needs title and start. start is YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM for a timed one; a timed start also needs timezone (such as Europe/Paris) or a Z or offset like +07:00. Set end or duration_minutes (default 60 minutes). Returns a Google Calendar link and .ics text that imports into any calendar app. Nothing is stored and no calendar is changed until the user saves the event.

description.description: Event agenda, notes, or participant details.

duration_minutes.description: Duration in minutes if end date-time is omitted (for example, 30 or 60).

end.description: Optional end in the same format as start, such as "2026-11-02T10:30". For an all-day event, the last day, such as "2026-11-04".

location.description: Meeting room, street address, or video call URL.

reminder_minutes.description: Minutes before the event to trigger an alarm/reminder (for example, 10 or 15).

start.description: Start as YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event, such as "2026-11-02", or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM for a timed event, such as "2026-11-02T09:30". A timed start needs timezone, or a Z or offset at the end such as "2026-11-02T09:30+07:00".

timezone.description: IANA time zone name in Area/City form, such as America/New_York, Europe/Paris or Asia/Tokyo. Needed for a timed start that has no Z or offset.

name: create_calendar_event

filename.description: Suggested file name for the .ics file.

google_calendar_url.description: Google Calendar web intent link with pre-populated fields.

notes.description: Short notes to pass on to the user, including any warning.

status.description: Always ok when the event was built. Bad input returns an error instead.

url_length.description: Length of the Google Calendar URL.

warning.description: Warning if URL exceeds safe limits.

title: Create calendar event
